title: ozothamnus obcordatus subsp. major
intro: Ozothamnus obcordatus subsp. major, commonly known as Major Bitter Pea Bush or Major Ozothamnus, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. The leaves of this plant have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ozothamnus obcordatus subsp. major include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential risks of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
